newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanbo Steel to be sold in July-creditor.
newsitem.headline: Hanbo Steel to be sold in July-creditor.

text.p: Creditors of the failed Hanbo Steel Co will sell the company in an open tender on July 8, Korea First Bank said on Thursday.
The bank said business conglomerates, individual companies and consortiums of steel-related firms whose financial status is sound would be allowed to participate in the tender.
Korea First Bank is Hanbo's prime creditor.
In a July 1 briefing, creditors would explain conditions of the tender, including financing, and the results of their investigation into Hanbo's financial status.
Hanbo Steel collapsed in January after piling up $5.8 billion in debts.
Hanbo officials said the company's heavy investment in expanding a steel mill in Tangjin, south of Seoul, led to its collapse.
